verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a CLI and a REST API for scripting installation, configuration, sessions and data retrieval. These are developer building blocks that a user must drive from external scripts or deployment tools. The evidence shows no product-native way to define automations that run on their own in the background, such as scheduled or triggered jobs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
